creative_checks.name: Creative Lab tab and panels fit the existing Sanctum at phone width
user-authored voice profile saves with revision and example permission
audience text is filtered and author identities are not stored
repeat observations do not inflate demand counts
audience CSV handles untrusted text and drops author columns
audience observations and channel guidance are frozen with the filming brief
metric-blind review flags voice conflicts payoff timing and reference wording
review flags lead to the saved script rather than dead report text
local assistant context carries bounded project voice guidance without claiming training
changed guidance invalidates an old creative review
actual supplied retention points link to transcript intervals and preserve unknown sample size
retention review seeks into the imported local video
missing retention points cannot quietly become zero
metadata backup restores voice audience reviews and retention together
portable project packs carry the new creative records and original media together
hostile restored review references are rejected without committing a changed library
creative records remain project-scoped
all four lab panels fit a 390px viewport
playbook audience review and retention survive full offline restart
no uncaught errors model calls or audience uploads

environment: Isolated Chrome profiles at 390px on the existing Windows build host; synthetic text, media and analytics, not actual audience outcomes.
limitations: The channel profile is user-authored guidance, not a trained model.
Review flags and exact-word similarity are heuristics, not semantic originality or outcome predictions.
Retention is user-imported; no platform account connection is established.
Audience filtering is partial, not complete anonymisation.
No claim that these features are unique across all competing products.
